title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 10: Mai Masaki
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．１０ ～真崎麻衣～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 10: Masaki Mai is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Mai Masaki. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.
